{{Quote|We call this the flames of Eluthan|Toma|<ref name="LOTJDW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref>}}
The '''flames of Eluthan''' were a natural phenomenon when the [[Star/Legends|sun]] that [[Acherin]] orbited set, making the standing stones in the canyon near the capital city of [[Eluthan]] glow a fiery [[Color/Legends|orange]]. While the sides of the canyon walls went into deep black due to the shadows, while the sky turned from yellow into a navy blue as it went from day to night.<ref name="LOTJDW" /> Additionally in Eluthan, the soft golden color dwellings would change to a liquid fire color during the sunset.<ref name="LOTJATE">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]''</ref> [[Raina Quill]], [[Toma (resistance leader)|Toma]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ferus Olin]], and [[Trever Flume]] bore witness to the flames of Eluthan as they escaped the capital cities bombardment.<ref name="LOTJDW" />
